- A11: Code review and documentation finalization. 2 days.

technical_and_design_decisions: Implement Gemfire binder using Spring Cloud Stream's Binder SPI to integrate with Spring Cloud Stream messaging.
Implement Gemfire SPI for Spring Cloud Dataflow to allow orchestration of data microservices using Gemfire as the underlying middleware.
Implement Gemfire as stream repository and module registry for Spring Cloud Dataflow using existing repository/registry interfaces.
Implement tap support by extending the stream processing pipeline to allow forking data streams without affecting the original stream.
Use Apache Geode (Gemfire) client API for all interactions with the Gemfire distributed system.
Documentation will be written in Markdown and integrated into the existing Spring Cloud Dataflow documentation structure.
assumptions: The developer has prior experience with Spring Cloud Stream, Spring Cloud Dataflow, and Apache Geode/Gemfire.
The existing Spring Cloud Stream and Spring Cloud Dataflow frameworks are fully functional and require no modifications beyond adding the Gemfire module.
Gemfire is available as a library dependency and is compatible with Java 17+ as required by Spring Framework 6.0.
All development, testing, and documentation tasks are performed by a single developer.
Effort estimates assume typical productivity with no major unforeseen blockers.
Unit and integration tests are considered part of each implementation activity.
Documentation includes code examples and deployment manifest explanations as per user stories.

activities.activity_description: Analyze all eight user stories, design the overall architecture for integrating Gemfire into Spring Cloud Stream and Spring Cloud Dataflow, and define interfaces and data models.

activities.activity_name: Implement Gemfire Binder for Spring Cloud Stream
activities.activity_description: Develop the Gemfire message-channel binder by implementing the Binder interface, handling message production and consumption via Gemfire regions/queues, and writing unit and integration tests.

activities.activity_name: Implement Gemfire SPI for Spring Cloud Dataflow
activities.activity_description: Implement the Gemfire SPI to enable orchestration of data microservices, including configuration and lifecycle management using Gemfire primitives.
Implement the stream repository interface using Gemfire to persist and retrieve stream definitions, including CRUD operations.
Implement the module registry interface using Gemfire to store and manage module metadata and deployment information.

activities.activity_name: Write Documentation on Deployment Manifest with Partitions
activities.activity_description: Write documentation explaining deployment manifests, how to configure partitions, and include relevant examples for Spring Cloud Dataflow streams using Gemfire.
Write documentation on direct binding for streams, including a complete example with the provided command-line arguments and explanation of the configuration.
Implement the tap functionality in the stream processing backend to allow forking a primary stream's data to a secondary analysis stream without impacting the original.

activities.activity_name: Implement Tap Support in Spring Cloud Dataflow DSL/Shell
activities.activity_description: Extend the Spring Cloud Dataflow DSL and shell commands to support creating and managing taps on streams.
Perform end-to-end integration testing across all implemented features, debug issues, and ensure all user stories are verified working together.
Conduct self-review of code, finalize all documentation for accuracy and completeness, and ensure all artifacts meet quality standards.
